Maintenance Engineer – Jenbacher Job at African Industries Group




        
    

        
        African Industries Group (AIG) is a diversified global conglomerate with a legacy of 52 years of business excellence and sustainable growth. It is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has been contributing to Nigeria’s socio-economic growth and industrial development and is equally committed towards the nurturing and development of the local community.

We are recruiting qualified and experienced professionals to join our team across Power Plant Operations, Maintenance, and Projects in the capacity below:

 Job Position: Maintenance Engineer – Jenbacher

Job Location: Ogijo Ikorodu - Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Qualifications
     

            
    




	B.Tech Degree in Mechanical Engineering with 5 years experience
	Minimum of 2 years of Power Plant experience with Jenbacher engines
	The Power Plant experience requirements are mandatory.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send a copy of their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Medical Officer Job at St. Ives Specialist Hospital




        
    

        
        St. Ives Specialist Hospital is a leading multi-specialist healthcare facility established in 1996. The hospital provides dedicated specialist services in women’s health, children’s health, and family healthcare, delivered by a team of experienced consultants in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Paediatrics, Medicine, and Surgery.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Medical Officer
Job Location: Akowonjo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Conducting medical examinations and assessments of patients.
	Diagnosing and treating acute and chronic illnesses.
	Ordering and interpreting diagnostic tests such as blood tests, X-rays, and MRIs.
	Prescribing medications and other treatments as necessary.
	Collaborating with other healthcare professionals to develop comprehensive treatment plans.
	Providing counselling and education to patients about their health conditions and treatment options.
	Monitoring patients' progress and adjusting treatment plans as needed.
	Maintaining accurate and up-to-date medical records.
	Participating in multidisciplinary team meetings to discuss patient care and treatment strategies.
	Adhering to all relevant medical laws, regulations, and ethical standards.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using "Medical Officer - Akowonjo" as the subject of the email.
